ensure_fitted_raise: ensure all ScaleFactor modules in a PyTorch nn.Module are fitted or raise a ValueError
ensure_fitted_warn: check all ScaleFactor modules are fitted and log a warning instead of raising an error
review_ensure_fitted: review the ensure_fitted function that validates ScaleFactor modules are fitted before inference
summarize_ensure_fitted: summarize the ensure_fitted utility function for checking fitted scale factors in a model
test_ensure_fitted: test the ensure_fitted function with a model containing unfitted ScaleFactor modules
